warnings: THIS SHEET IS AN ALTERNATIVE, NOT A CONFLICT WITH S-01. The printed condition is explicit at the bottom of the sheet: หากดินมีกำลังแบกทาน (BEARING CAPACITY) ไม่น้อยกว่า 8 ตัน/ตร.ม. ให้ใช้ฐานรากตามแบบรายละเอียดโดยไม่ต้องใช้เสาเข็มได้. So S-01's pile foundation (F1/F2 on เสาเข็ม 0.18x0.18) and this sheet's spread footings (F1/F1.5/F1.8) are two designs for the same house, chosen by soil test. The mark F1 exists on BOTH sheets meaning different things - a 1.0x1.0 spread footing here, a pile cap on S-01 - which is why each sheet is kept in its own file rather than merged.

COLUMN POSITIONS ARE IDENTICAL TO S-01, position for position: 16 columns, C2 at ง2/ง3/ค2/ค3 and C1 everywhere else. Cross-checked one by one against both S-01 views. That agreement is what makes the size mapping below trustworthy even though the footing outlines here are drawn as light dashed squares.

F1 vs F1.5 ON THE BOTTOM TWO ROWS IS THE LEAST CERTAIN READING ON THIS SHEET. The labels on the ข and ก rows are printed small and overlap the C1 tags. Read as: ข1/ข2/ข3 = F1.5, ข4 = F1, ก1/ก2 = F1. That gives 3 + 9 + 4 = 16, matching the column count exactly, which is the strongest check available. Flagged rather than stated as certain; a later pass on the full-size sheet should confirm the four smallest squares.

The three footing sizes and their reinforcement are printed on the same sheet in the ฐานรากแผ่ section detail (see the separate _view2 file): F 1.0 = 6+6 Ø12#, F 1.5 = 8+8 Ø16 มม.#, F 1.8 = 10+10 Ø16 มม.#, with thicknesses 0.20 / 0.25 / 0.30 m and a 1.20 m founding depth below ±0.00.
POINT ELEMENTS MERGED PER §4: one entry per mark with count + grid_refs. The three footing marks' grid_refs do not overlap, so 3 + 9 + 4 is a genuine total and not a double count.
